panels.description: All-time unique review identities for the selected application.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(id) AS value FROM reviews WHERE application_id = NULLIF(${application_id:sqlstring}, '')::uuid;

panels.title: Unique reviews (all time)

panels.description: All-time persisted observations for reviews belonging to the selected application.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(o.review_id) AS value FROM review_observations o JOIN reviews r ON r.id = o.review_id WHERE r.application_id = NULLIF(${application_id:sqlstring}, '')::uuid;

panels.title: Observations (all time)

panels.description: Selected-application tasks currently marked failed and created in the dashboard range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(id) AS value FROM crawl_tasks WHERE application_id = NULLIF(${application_id:sqlstring}, '')::uuid AND status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(created_at);

panels.title: Failed tasks (selected range)

panels.description: Most recently created task for the selected application, including actual task locale.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "Created", task_type AS "Task type", status AS "Status", language_code AS "Language", country_code AS "Country", attempt_count AS "Recorded attempts" FROM crawl_tasks WHERE application_id = NULLIF(${application_id:sqlstring}, '')::uuid ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Last crawl task

panels.description: Recent selected-application tasks without raw error messages.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "Created", task_type AS "Task type", status AS "Status", attempt_count AS "Recorded attempts", error_code AS "Error code", started_at AS "Started", finished_at AS "Finished" FROM crawl_tasks WHERE application_id = NULLIF(${application_id:sqlstring}, '')::uuid AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Crawl history

panels.description: Current unique-review score distribution for the selected application.

targets.rawSql: SELECT score::text || ' stars' AS metric, count(id) AS value FROM reviews WHERE application_id = NULLIF(${application_id:sqlstring}, '')::uuid GROUP BY score ORDER BY score;

panels.title: Current rating distribution

panels.description: Persisted observation count over time for the selected application.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', o.observed_at) AS "time", count(o.review_id) AS "Observations" FROM review_observations o JOIN reviews r ON r.id = o.review_id WHERE r.application_id = NULLIF(${application_id:sqlstring}, '')::uuid AND $__timeFilter(o.observed_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Review activity

panels.description: Average elapsed seconds by completion bucket and task type for the selected application.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(finished_at, '1h'), task_type AS metric, avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at - started_at))) AS value FROM crawl_tasks WHERE application_id = NULLIF(${application_id:sqlstring}, '')::uuid AND $__timeFilter(finished_at) AND started_at IS NOT NULL AND finished_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Average task duration

panels.description: Actual persisted task locales for the selected application, not a global default assumption.

targets.rawSql: SELECT language_code AS "Language", country_code AS "Country", count(id) AS "Tasks" FROM crawl_tasks WHERE application_id = NULLIF(${application_id:sqlstring}, '')::uuid AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY language_code, country_code ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1, 2;

panels.title: Task language and country

panels.description: Available observation-level sentiment results for the selected application; missing labels remain explicit.

targets.rawSql: SELECT o.sentiment_status AS "Status", coalesce(o.sentiment_label, 'not assigned') AS "Label", count(o.review_id) AS "Observations" FROM review_observations o JOIN reviews r ON r.id = o.review_id WHERE r.application_id = NULLIF(${application_id:sqlstring}, '')::uuid GROUP BY o.sentiment_status, o.sentiment_label ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Sentiment status and label
